details.name: MOB.134_Work_Form_Fill
details.message:
`MOB.134` **Fill out an inserted form** — T2.1's last forms item.
- **SELF-RESTORING**: leg 1 writes `DD FORM EDIT`, leg 2 clears the field back to empty,
  which MOB.977 measured as its rest state.
- **Targets `#apm-dv-tabpanel`, NOT `#senor-work-form`.** `FormDetails.tsx:106` renders
  the desktop form whenever `screen.availWidth >= 750`; chrome.tablet is above that, so
  the phone container this test used to target cannot exist here. That, not a locator
  typo, is why it never passed.
- **Opens the FIRST form card in the visible panel** rather than naming one. The
  `Inspection` form it used to name is no longer on the fixture (MOB.977 probe C3), and
  matching that name as a substring spans Mantine's keepMounted tab panels (trap 3).
- **Fields save on BLUR, one at a time** — there is no form-level submit, so the test
  types then Tabs. Typing alone saves nothing.
- The `Field updated` toast IS server-confirmed (inside `update()`, no
  `optimisticResponse`) but transient, so it is asserted before the 5000ms autoClose and
  still only optional. **The durable proof is the re-navigation + JS read.**
- Each leg walks work list → work order → Forms tab → the card, because
  `MOBILE_WORK_FORM` is `cache-only` and the page renders blank if deep-linked.
